business_summary: Tomoegawa Corporation engages in the manufacture, process, and sale of electronics parts, display parts, fine particles, functional sheets, and specialty paper products primarily in Japan. The company offers heat, electricity, electromagnetic wave control related products, such as high performance heat sink and planar heater, heat resistant removable adhesive tape, and thermal conductive insulation adhesive sheet, as well as high insulation adhesive tape; and electronics parts, including lead frame fixing tapes, adhesive tapes, electrode coating, and electrostatic chucks, as well as adhesives for hermetic seal packages. It also provides display products, such as optical adhesive and light control films; fine particle materials, including magnetic toners, non-magnetic toners, full color toners, and new development toners; record printing sheets comprising inkjet, laser printer, sublimation printer paper, and thermal recording paper; magnetic recording sheets consisting of magnetic passenger ticket and special fiber sheets, including inorganic fiber and fluorine fiber sheets, as well as calcium carbonate paper. In addition, the company offers optical plug assembly cleaner and refractive index matching film; insulating paper for cables and transformers; industrial paper, such as conductive paper, water absorption paper, and sterilizing paper; and sound transmission sheets, optical connector cleaner, cellulose fiber compound, copper and stainless fiber sheet, functional powder holding sheet, and conversion sheet. Further, it engages in the manufacturing and sale of cards, documents, magnetic recording-related products, etc., as well as engages in information processing-related businesses; and real estate leasing and logistics services. Tomoegawa Corporation was founded in 1914 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Tomoegawa Corporation은 주로 일본에서 전자 부품, 디스플레이 부품, 미립자, 기능성 시트 및 특수 종이 제품의 제조, 가공 및 판매에 종사하고 있습니다. 고성능 방열판 및 면상 히터, 내열성 탈착 테이프, 열전도 절연 접착 시트, 고절연 접착 테이프 등 열, 전기, 전자파 제어 관련 제품을 제공하는 회사입니다. 리드프레임 고정테이프, 접착테이프, 전극도장, 정전척 등 전자부품과 밀봉포장용 접착제 등을 취급하고 있습니다. 또한 광학접착제, 광제어 필름 등의 디스플레이 제품도 제공합니다. 자성 토너, 비자성 토너, 풀 컬러 토너, 신개발 토너를 포함한 미립자 재료; 잉크젯, 레이저 프린터, 승화 프린터 용지 및 감열 기록지로 구성된 기록 인쇄 시트; 자기승차권과 무기섬유, 불소섬유시트 등의 특수섬유시트, 탄산칼슘지로 구성된 자기기록시트. 또한 이 회사는 광학 플러그 어셈블리 클리너 및 굴절 제품을 제공합니다.
